cards.title: Forms in Angular
cards.content:
Forms

Angular provides two approaches to handling forms: Template-driven (relies on directives in the template) and Reactive (programmatic approach using form control objects).

cards.title: Reactive Forms
cards.content:
Reactive Forms

Reactive forms use FormControl, FormGroup, and FormArray to track value and validity. They are robust, scalable, and reusable.

profileForm = new FormGroup({
  name: new FormControl(''),
});

cards.title: Validators
cards.content:
Validators

Validators are functions that validate form inputs. Common ones include Validators.required, Validators.minLength(3), and Validators.pattern().

content.prompt: The Form___ service provides syntactic sugar that shortens creating instances of a FormControl, FormGroup, or FormArray.
